controller_actions.task: Write module.py and test_cases.json for the user contract. module.py: define solve(data) using only standard-library imports if any. For each item in data, normalize name with strip().casefold(); if the normalized name is empty, skip it. Return a list of {"name": normalized_name, "quantity": total} sorted by name, preserving zero totals. An empty input returns []. Do not mutate the input. test_cases.json: a JSON list of at least four distinct cases. Each case has "input" plus exactly one of "output" (expected JSON result) or "error" (exception class name such as "ValueError"). Optional fields such as "name" or "notes" are allowed. Cover: normal aggregation, whitespace and case normalization, skipped empty names, zero totals kept, negative quantity error, negative quantity on a skipped name raising error, and empty input. Expectations must match the user contract exactly.
